svg.title: Hypertunnel — TCP over discrete HTTP
svg.desc: A detailed continuous engineering schematic. Blue upload paths run down the local client, across an encrypted HTTP POST, and up the remote server. Teal download paths run down the server, across the response to a waiting client GET, and up the local client. Twenty numbered stages show TCP reads and writes, per-socket batching and routing, sequence-number assignment and waiting, Borsh serialization and deserialization, and authenticated encryption. Three example socket IDs retain their identities throughout the tunnel. Side rails connect the same application and destination sockets to their read and write stages. Supporting diagrams show session establishment, the HTTP request and response directions, and socket-record fields. Transfer details reflect the current implementation; sequence numbers do not imply retransmission or recovery from missing batches.
